reference: procps-ng uptime, run by the harness with Bash as the reference shell and LC_ALL=C; only usage errors are compared (status recorded on stdout, stderr bytes), since the uptime itself differs between runs.
coverage: Pass 8 (G119, G120): unknown options and operands print the procps message and usage with status 1.

cases.purpose: G119: an unknown long option prints the procps usage on stderr, status 1.
G119: an unknown short option, status 1.
G119: an operand is a usage error, status 1.
